title: ActionPlanTemplateVersion - Data API
description: Represents the version of an action plan template. This object is available in API version 44.0 and later.

ActionPlanTemplateId.description: The ID of the action plan template this version represents.

ActivationDateTime.description: The date and time at which this version became active.

InactivationDateTime.description: The date and time at which this version became inactive.

IsLocked.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsLocked.description: Indicates whether this action plan template version is locked or not. The default value is false.

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user viewed this record.

MayEdit.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
MayEdit.description: Indicates whether this action plan template version can be edited. The default value is false.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update,
Name.description: The name of this version item.

Status.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: The action plan template version’s state. Possible values are: Draft Final – Published Obsolete ReadOnly

Version.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
Version.description: The index number of this action plan template version.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **ActionPlanTemplateVersionChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
- **ActionPlanTemplateVersionFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **ActionPlanTemplateVersionHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **ActionPlanTemplateVersionOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **ActionPlanTemplateVersionShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
